messages:
rachel-peopleops: Heads-up, offer for Cam (NY remote), manager requests comp uplift band6->band7 and immediate eligibility for parental leave. Start date 2026-03-15 but payroll earliest benefit enrollment is 2026-03-29. Can we approve parental leave eligibility to count from day one and align equity vesting start to hire date?

sam-hiring: Candidate accepted verbally. Manager says parental leave accommodation is a deal point (they need to take leave ~6 weeks after start for family reasons). Also wants equity cliff to begin on 03/15 not payroll date.

ida-comp: Band uplift materially affects comp bands and budget; need VP comp and CFO sign-off for band7. Equity grant date shift possible if comp/admin approves but must match grant paperwork.

omar-finance: Payroll note: benefits and FMLA/parental eligibility require employer records to show hire date. We can grant eligibility in HR system effective 03/15 with documented exception, but payroll and 401(k) matching will still process on 03/29. There may be small one-time adjustments. Need CFO ok.

leah-legal: Legal OK to record eligibility from start date if signed offer shows 03/15 and exception memo is in file. For equity, legal needs to confirm grant documentation and comp committee sign-off; cannot promise board-level grant date without approvals. Parental leave policy compliance depends on state rules; NY requires certain documentation but we can flag it. Recommend capping any retro financial adjustments to 21 days.

rachel-peopleops: Proposed path: 1) Provisional band7 uplift pending CFO + VP comp. 2) Approve parental leave eligibility effective 03/15 (HR record) with payroll enrollments on 03/29. 3) Allow equity cliff to be anchored to 03/15 pending comp/legal confirmation. 4) Cap any payroll retro adjustments to 21 days. Approve?

ida-comp: Conditional yes pending VP comp sign-off and comp committee for equity date. I'll start the approval thread with VP.

omar-finance: OK conditional on CFO. I'll prepare quick cost delta for uplift and estimated one-time payroll adj.

talent-bot: Tasks created: "request-vp-comp" -> @ida-comp (due 2026-03-05); "cfo-approval" -> @omar-finance (due 2026-03-05); "issue-updated-offer" -> @rachel-peopleops (due 2026-03-06).

ida-comp: VP-comp signed off in DM: supports band7 if CFO approves budget. Starting comp committee note for equity grant date.

omar-finance: Maria-CFO pinged; uplift delta annual ~= $22,400, one-time payroll adj estimate ~$120. Maria says she'll review.

maria-cfo: (via DM) Reviewed. Approve band7 uplift and HR-record parental leave eligibility effective 03/15. Finance will absorb small payroll adj and track under code EXC-PARENT-03. Equity grant date must be confirmed by comp committee/legal.

leah-legal: Comp committee confirmed ability to set grant date to 03/15 for this grant; legal will draft grant memo. Approving exception wording: "People Ops and Finance approve parental leave eligibility effective 2026-03-15; payroll enrollments on 2026-03-29; band uplift approved; equity grant date to be set to hire date pending comp committee confirmation."

rachel-peopleops: Approved wording. Issued updated offer PDF with effective date 03/15 and note about parental eligibility. Candidate signed at 09:38. HR record updated and exception filed EXC-2026-301. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
